headline: Xiaomi's MIMO rockets to #1; Anthropic takes a tumble
summary: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5-20260422 vaulted 6 spots to claim the top position with 14.0% token share, gaining 8.4 percentage points in a single day. Meanwhile, Anthropic's claude-opus-5 dropped 8 ranks to #11, shedding 5.7 percentage points—the day's sharpest single-model decline. DeepSeek remains the dominant provider at 22.2% share but lost 3.5 points on the day, while Xiaomi's provider share jumped to 14.5%.
highlights: Xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-20260422 surges from rank 7 to #1 (+8.4pp token share in 1 day)
OpenAI/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 climbs to rank 4 with 7.9% share, up 31 spots in 30 days
